title: PIPELINE.jsonl is append-at-end, so every merge re-conflicts every other open PR — make it merge-safe
note:
WAVE 2, operator-selected 2026-09-24 ~15:55Z (popup). Dispatched by session_01Ljhs6sFAdWHdMDhJpL5aBP. MEASURED 2026-09-24 by session_01Ljhs6sFAdWHdMDhJpL5aBP: of 9 green lane PRs, each squash merge re-conflicted the rest ONLY on docs/claude/work/PIPELINE.jsonl (E53, E56, E54, E59, D3, A10, E55 twice, E60, E51). Each re-resolve costs a ~20-minute CI cycle, and it forced an integration PR (#12858) that pr-landing-guard R12 had to hold. GitHub server-side merges do not honour .gitattributes merge drivers, so a union driver does not help. Options: one file per item (docs/claude/work/pipeline/<id>.jsonl), or per-session shard files that pipeline.py reads as one store. Must keep pipeline.py --check, pipeline-guard and render_section_0 working, and keep append-only semantics.
MANAGER R12 READ of #12876 (delegated by the operator) found one BLOCKING gap. A flat PIPELINE.jsonl recreated by resolving a modify/delete conflict would be silently ignored, because the default store is the directory, so the rows it carries would be lost. Sent back; the lane fixed it at 8ed088f (--check refuses flat+dir coexisting; the migration is idempotent and incremental; the resolver recipe is in the PR body). Ceiling $30 breached ($39.48): the fix round was manager-requested.
